steps.title: After the Tyrant appears
steps.rule: Go to 3m west of the centre.

OffTank.rule: Go to 3m north-east of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Go to 3m south-east of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Go to 3m east of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Go to 3m east of the centre.

steps.title: After Explosion cast starts
steps.rule: Stand near waymark 1, the north-west wall.

ShieldHealer.rule: Stand near waymark 3, the south-east wall.

CasterDps.rule: Stand near waymark 2, the north-east wall.

steps.title: After Explosion resolves
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: WestShadesNear has true).

MainTank.rule: Depends on WestShadesNear and AvalancheSafeSide: [true,false] & 1 → near B (E 8m); [true,false] & -1 → near D (W 8m); [false,true] & -1 → near D (W 8m); [false,true] & 1 → near D (W 8m).

MeleeDpsA.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Avalanche).

MeleeDpsB.rule: Depends on WestShadesNear: [true,false] → near B (E 8m); [false,true] → at D.

PhysRangedDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LinesWestOuter has false).

CasterDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LinesWestOuter has true).

steps.title: After a marker lands on you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: Avalanche).

OffTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: WestShadesNear has true).

ShieldHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: AvalancheSafeZ).

MeleeDpsA.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LinesWestOuter).

MeleeDpsB.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: WestShadesNear).

PhysRangedDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LinesWestOuter).

CasterDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LinesWestOuter has true).

steps.title: After Fire Breath hits you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LinesWestOuter has false).

MainTank.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: WestShadesNear).

OffTank.rule: Depends on LinesWestOuter has true and AvalancheSafeSide: yes & 1 → at B; yes & -1 → at D; no & 1 → at D; no & -1 → at B.

MeleeDpsA.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LinesWestOuter).

MeleeDpsB.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LinesWestOuter has true).

PhysRangedDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LinesWestOuter has true).

steps.title: After Massive Meteor hits you
steps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: WestShadesNear).

OffTank.rule: Depends on LinesWestOuter has true and AvalancheSafeSide: yes & 1 → near 2 (NE wall); yes & -1 → near 1 (NW wall); no & 1 → near 1 (NW wall); no & -1 → near 2 (NE wall).

RegenHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LinesWestOuter has false).

ShieldHealer.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LinesWestOuter has false).

MeleeDpsA.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LinesWestOuter).

MeleeDpsB.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LinesWestOuter has true).

PhysRangedDps.rule: The spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show; read the strat (closest roll: LinesWestOuter has true).

steps.title: After Arcadion Avalanche resolves
steps.rule: Depends on Avalanche: 0 → NE wall; 3 → NW wall; 2 → SW wall; 1 → SE wall.

steps.title: After Arcadion Avalanche resolves
steps.rule: Depends on Avalanche: 0 → near 2 (NE wall); 3 → near 1 (NW wall); 2 → near 4 (SW wall); 1 → near 3 (SE wall).
